name: figma-mcp
description: Figma MCP: list frames in a file and fetch one frame's JSON and image safely. 2 tools.

tools.name: list_frames
tools.description: List and optionally filter all top-level FRAME nodes in a Figma file.

tools.name: fetch_frame
tools.description: Fetch one Figma frame and write its PNG, node JSON, and image-fill map into the output directory.

figma_token.title: Figma token
figma_token.description: Figma personal access token with file_content:read

api_base_url.title: API base URL
api_base_url.description: Override the Figma REST API base URL

max_json_bytes.title: Max JSON response bytes
max_json_bytes.description: Upper bound on a Figma JSON response, in bytes

max_frame_bytes.title: Max frame PNG bytes
max_frame_bytes.description: Upper bound on a downloaded frame PNG, in bytes

output_root.title: Output root
output_root.description: Directory that all fetch_frame output directories must stay below
